info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Management Reward Points Accounts-spec
info.description: The Reward Points Account Management API enables users to efficiently access and manage their reward points accounts. Through this endpoint, clients can retrieve detailed information about various reward points accounts linked to their banking profiles. This functionality is essential for consumers looking to monitor their reward points accumulation and redeem options. Typical users include banking customers and financial applications that integrate reward points information for enhanced user experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific reward points account, including points balance and transaction history. Use this to check the status and details of reward points associated with an account.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the reward points account associated with a specific account. Please ensure to adhere to the required schema as outlined in the components section.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the reward points account information.
